scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/site build && bun run --cwd apps/dashboard build
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.test: bun test --pass-with-no-tests apps/dashboard/src apps/site/src packages/schemas/src packages/ui/src
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/site/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/schemas/tsconfig.json
